keyPoints.en: Nervous system = central (brain, spinal cord) + peripheral (nerves).
keyPoints.bm: Sistem saraf = pusat (otak, saraf tunjang) + periferi (saraf).

keyPoints.en: Brain: cerebrum (thinking, voluntary), cerebellum (balance), medulla oblongata (heartbeat, breathing).
keyPoints.bm: Otak: serebrum (berfikir, terkawal), serebelum (keseimbangan), medula oblongata (denyutan jantung, pernafasan).

keyPoints.en: Reflex arc: receptor → afferent → interneurone → efferent → effector — fast and automatic.
keyPoints.bm: Arka refleks: reseptor → aferen → perantaraan → eferen → efektor — pantas dan automatik.

keyPoints.en: Sense organs: eye (light), ear (sound, balance), nose (smell), tongue (taste), skin (touch, pressure, heat, cold, pain).
keyPoints.bm: Organ deria: mata (cahaya), telinga (bunyi, keseimbangan), hidung (bau), lidah (rasa), kulit (sentuhan, tekanan, panas, sejuk, sakit).

keyPoints.en: Vision defects: short-sightedness (concave lens), long-sightedness (convex lens), astigmatism (cylindrical lens).
keyPoints.bm: Kecacatan penglihatan: rabun jauh (kanta cekung), rabun dekat (kanta cembung), astigmatisme (kanta silinder).

keyPoints.en: Humans hear about 20 Hz – 20 000 Hz; loud noise can permanently damage hearing.
keyPoints.bm: Manusia mendengar kira-kira 20 Hz – 20 000 Hz; bunyi kuat boleh merosakkan pendengaran secara kekal.

keyPoints.en: Shoots: positive phototropism, negative geotropism. Roots: positive geotropism and hydrotropism.
keyPoints.bm: Pucuk: fototropisme positif, geotropisme negatif. Akar: geotropisme dan hidrotropisme positif.

keyPoints.en: Nastic movements do not depend on the direction of the stimulus (e.g. semalu).
keyPoints.bm: Gerak balas nastik tidak bergantung pada arah rangsangan (cth. semalu).

keyPoints.en: Stereoscopic: eyes in front, overlapping fields, accurate distance — predators, primates.
keyPoints.bm: Stereoskopik: mata di hadapan, medan bertindih, jarak tepat — pemangsa, primat.

keyPoints.en: Monocular: eyes on the sides, wide field of view — prey animals.
keyPoints.bm: Monokular: mata di sisi, medan penglihatan luas — haiwan mangsa.
